Subject: Qualify: security & telemetry follow-up + ops next steps

Hi Alex / HealthCore security team —

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick written recap + clear next steps so we can keep momentum from the demo/discovery: we covered product fit, expected call volumes, and a number of security/compliance items you flagged. Below is what we captured and what we can deliver this week.

Recap (short):
- HealthCore is evaluating Redwood for low-latency inference for clinical summarization (non-PHI for now, but you indicated potential PHI in future pilots).
- Key asks: SOC 2 status, GDPR/HIPAA applicability, vendor security questionnaire, and mapping of telemetry/cookies from both the Console and docs site.

Immediate asks / action items (what we need from you):
1) Please confirm whether your initial pilot will process PHI (yes/no). If yes, we should start BAA discussions.
2) I attached a short telemetry mapping template (redwood-telemetry-mapping-v1.xlsx) — can you fill the shaded columns about expected page flows and sample API paths?
3) We attached a one-page SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf). For completeness: Redwood has a rolling SOC 2 Type II target (audit in progress) — happy to share the latest report once finalized; we can provide interim evidence for key controls.

What Redwood will do this week:
- Start the vendor questionnaire you shared on the call (we'll need the spreadsheet and any internal SLA/retention specifics).
- Pull together a DPA draft and a subprocessors list for your review.
- Answer Console vs Docs telemetry: short answer is that the Console emits product telemetry (request latency, model id, tokens) and the public docs site uses analytics cookies (DocSite-ANON) for page usage; we can provide a mapping of specific cookie names/IDs.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, stub)], [Attachment: redwood-telemetry-mapping-v1.xlsx (xlsx, stub)]

Suggested next steps:
- Can we aim to exchange vendor questionnaire and initial SOC evidence by Tue, Jun 1?
- If helpful, schedule a 30-min security walkthrough next Wed to cover controls + BAA scoping.

Happy to jump on a call with your security folks — looping Lauren for contract questions and next steps on our side.

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@healthcore.ai>

Subject: Re: Qualify: security & telemetry follow-up + ops next steps

Sergio — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the attachments. Quick answers from our side below, plus a couple of items we'll need from Redwood.

1) PHI: For the initial sandbox pilot — NO PHI. We anticipate a PHI-containing production pilot later this year; we'll flag when that scope changes. If/when we progress to PHI, we'll need a signed BAA.

2) Vendor questionnaire: attached is our standard security questionnaire (healthcore-sq.xlsx). Can Redwoods security/compliance team fill sections A–D (controls, incident response, encryption)? We'd like the initial pass by Tue, Jun 1 if possible.

3) SOC 2: helpful to have the one-pager. Current state at HealthCore: we require at minimum SOC 2 Type II evidence for production handling of PHI. You mentioned audit in progress — can you provide: (a) expected SOC 2 completion timeline, and (b) any interim evidence (control summaries, penetration test results)?

4) Telemetry & cookies: thanks for the quick note. A few clarifying questions for the mapping you sent: which telemetry fields include user identifiers (even hashed/pseudonymized)? Does the Console set any 1st-party cookies that persist beyond session (we try to avoid persistent identifiers unless consented)? Also, for the docs site, do you use any third-party analytic tags (e.g., Google Analytics, Segment)?

5) GDPR / Data residency: We operate primarily in the US but some of our pilots will include EU-based clinicians. For EU data subjects, we need clarity on data flows and subprocessors. Please include the data residency options and your EU region deployments in the DPA.

Attachments: [Attachment: healthcore-sq.xlsx (xlsx, stub)]

We can do a security call next Wed at 10am PT — that works for our team.

Thanks — I'll loop Maya (security engineer) into any technical mapping conversations.

—Alex
Alex Zhou
Head of Product Security | HealthCore AI
alex.zhou@healthcore.ai | (415) 555-2033
